findings.headline: Bessent unveils 'Operation Economic Outcast' — 'economic D-Day' press conference, sanctions on 60+ entities across 5 sectors
findings.source: NPR / NBC News / AP / CNN / CBS News
findings.summary: Treasury Secretary Bessent formally unveiled 'Operation Economic Outcast' at a press conference on August 24. Sanctions on 60+ entities aiding Iran across five key sectors: digital assets, technology, gold, aviation, and shipping. Broadened secondary sanctions on any country doing business with Iran. Bessent warned 'no one is above the reach of US sanctions.' Iran vows 'seismic' response. CNN reports Bessent sent message to Iranian soldiers to question their military leadership.

findings.headline: Bessent's 'Treasury Twist' buyback failing — New Yorker calls it 'The Humbling of Scott Bessent,' may tap $1T TGA account
findings.source: New Yorker / Fortune / CNBC / Bloomberg / NYT / Axios
findings.summary: Treasury Secretary Bessent doubled planned buybacks of 10-to-30-year Treasury securities from $2B to $4B per operation beginning Sep 9, after 30-year yield hit 5.34% (highest since 2007). Impact on yields was short-lived. CNBC reports Bessent may tap near $1T Treasury General Account to fund buybacks. Bloomberg: dollar will ultimately pay the price for this intervention. Federal debt exceeds $40 trillion, more than double 2017 level.

findings.headline: Japan Finance Minister Katayama signals further intervention possible after coordinated US-Japan yen action
findings.summary: Japan's historic yen intervention in early August coordinated with US Treasury. Yen strengthened from ~164 to ~155 but quickly surrendered gains, back toward 159. BOJ expected to hike to 1.25% with 80% probability. Carry trade 'turbo-charged' as Japanese investors bought 5T+ yen of foreign equities/bonds in two weeks ended Aug 15. US-Japan 10Y spread at ~1.8pp. Intervention failing to change fundamental carry trade incentives.

findings.headline: Iran warns of Hormuz ship seizures ahead of Bessent sanctions push; 60-day ceasefire window expired
findings.summary: Both sides missed the 60-day ceasefire window to reach a deal, closing off the formal truce mechanism aimed at ending the Middle East war now in its sixth month. Iran warns of ship seizures in Strait of Hormuz. OFAC issued alerts on sanctions risks of Iranian demands for Hormuz passage. CSIS analysts examining ongoing military implications.

findings.headline: Reuters photographer catches Treasury Secretary's pad at Camp David: 'buy Japanese yen, 5 to 10 billion'
findings.summary: At Camp David, a Reuters photographer caught the Treasury Secretary's notepad reading 'buy Japanese yen, 5 to 10 billion.' This revealed the scale of planned currency intervention. Japan holds $1.14T in US debt. As Japanese funds sell US bonds and drag yields up, the question becomes: Tokyo or Wall Street, who blinks first?

findings.headline: ECB cash stockpiling data reveals anxiety: EU households hoarding cash amid war, wildfire, cyber-attack fears
findings.summary: ECB data tracking bank notes in circulation since 2002 shows value hitting new highs. Households encouraged to have crisis packs including bottled water, transistor radio, canned food, and cash. Growth in cash stocks across EU signals deep public anxiety about systemic stability.

findings.headline: FT survey: Fed and BoE on hold, rate rises from ECB and Bank of Japan expected this year
findings.summary: FT August survey of economists: Fed and BoE will remain on hold, with rate rises from ECB and BOJ to come this year. BOJ 80% probability of move to 1.25%. Diverging central bank paths creating cross-currents in currency and bond markets.

findings.headline: Global bond markets put governments on notice over fiscal worries — Reuters
findings.summary: Bond market selling grips US, Japan, and China simultaneously over inflation and fiscal worries. 30-year Treasury yield at 5.34%, highest since 2007. This is a coordinated sovereign bond sell-off across major economies — a rare and dangerous signal.

findings.headline: ECB Governing Council meeting scheduled — press conference to follow
findings.summary: ECB monetary policy meeting in Frankfurt (Day 2) with press conference. Market watching for signals on rate path amid US debt spillover and European fiscal concerns.

findings.headline: US-Iran war in sixth month — Strait of Hormuz traffic collapsed to 9 vessel transits/day
findings.summary: US-Iran war ongoing since March 2026. Peace deal expired without restart. Strait of Hormuz shipping traffic collapsed to 9 vessel transits per day. IEA calls it 'largest supply disruption' event. Iran warns of ship seizures. $20M tanker voyage through Hormuz becoming measure of new energy economics. War repricing oil, gas, and shipping.

findings.headline: Fourth Taiwan Strait Crisis — Taiwan civilians training for defense, China military posture continues
findings.summary: Taiwan residents forming community emergency response teams to prepare for possible Chinese invasion. Fourth Taiwan Strait Crisis ongoing. Military drills and tensions from Taiwan to Iran signal intensifying major-power competition. NYT magazine feature on civilian defense preparation signals normalization of invasion fears.

findings.headline: Typhoon Dolphin disrupts major Chinese ports — Shanghai, Ningbo, Yantian berthing delays
findings.summary: Series of typhoons impacting port operations in China. Typhoon Dolphin causing significant disruption at Shanghai, Ningbo, and Yantian. Blank sailings and port call omissions announced. Berthing delays mounting.

findings.headline: Transpacific container rates surge — carriers cut capacity 9% East Coast, blank sailings planned
findings.summary: Seven blank sailings announced. Asia-to-US East Coast capacity fell 9% MoM in August. West Coast capacity down 0.4%. Carrier network changes, container shortages, limited allocations, weather disruptions, and geopolitical risks restricting shipper flexibility. September rate increases planned.

findings.headline: Panama Canal low-water crisis worsening — daily transits cut further Sep 3, again Sep 15
findings.summary: Panama Canal low-water issues deteriorating. Daily transits further limited by Panama Canal Authority as of Sep 3, another reduction Sep 15. Auction prices for transit slots increasing. Carriers charging Panama Canal surcharges. Weight limits in place. This will exacerbate Asia-to-East/Gulf Coast space pressures.

findings.headline: German port strikes and Rhine low water causing European congestion and delays
findings.summary: Port congestion across Asia and Europe. Labour strikes at German ports impacting schedule reliability. Low-water levels on Rhine continuing to pose challenges. European ocean and rail terminals experiencing congestion and delays.

findings.headline: Strait of Hormuz shipping collapse — $20M tanker voyages, war-risk premiums surging
findings.summary: Strait of Hormuz traffic collapsed to 9 vessel transits/day. $20M tanker voyage through Hormuz. War pushing up freight and insurance costs, restricting Iranian oil exports, intensifying Europe's competition for energy. IEA characterizes this as 'largest supply disruption'.

findings.headline: New US federal stablecoin rules wipe out interest payments on digital dollars — stablecoin market shrinking
findings.summary: New US federal stablecoin rules eliminated interest payments on digital dollars. Yield-seeking capital walking away. Stablecoin market peaked at $322.1B in mid-May, now declining. Category opened 2026 at $310B. Regulatory change structurally weakening the stablecoin ecosystem.

findings.headline: Bloomberg global regulatory brief: bank capital and liquidity risk modernization — amended regulations in force since July 16
findings.summary: Amended bank capital and liquidity regulations published in Government Gazette, came into force July 16, 2026. Revised disclosure, reporting, and COI requirements now in effect. No further consultation underway.

findings.headline: SEC imposes 5-year trading ban and 10-year registration ban on Ellison; 5-year trading and 8-year registration ban on Wang
findings.summary: Derivatives and regulatory weekly update: SEC orders impose trading and registration bans on Ellison and Wang (FTX-related). Five-year trading ban, 10-year registration ban on Ellison. Five-year trading ban, 8-year registration ban on Wang. Continued regulatory enforcement in crypto sector.

findings.headline: Iran internal crisis deepening — 4,229 protests in year ending March 2026, mass executions, government crackdowns
findings.summary: Post-Twelve-Day War domestic crisis in Iran characterized by domestic unrest, political instability, protests, and economic decline. Government responding with crackdowns, mass executions, arrests, militarization. 4,229 protests involving different sectors of Iranian society in the year ending March 2026. Protesters chanting 'Death to the Dictator.' Movement expanding beyond economic demands to calls for overthrow of Islamic Republic.

findings.headline: Gen Z protests across Asia — India NEET-UG exam paper leak, Delhi Jantar Mantar protests, movements in multiple countries
findings.summary: Gen Z protests across Asia linked to elite capture and insufficient inclusive development. India youth protests led by satirical Cockroach Janata Party over NEET-UG exam paper leak. Delhi Jantar Mantar protests ongoing. Rapper KR$NA's song becoming student protest anthem. Movement spreading across multiple Asian countries.

findings.headline: German school strikes against military service — tens of thousands of young people protesting
findings.summary: German school strikes against military service during late 2025 and 2026 involved tens of thousands of young people. Signals growing civil resistance to militarization in Europe amid escalating geopolitical tensions.

findings.headline: 30-year Treasury yield hits 5.34% — highest since 2007. Bessent doubles buybacks, dollar declines
findings.summary: 30-year Treasury yield surged to 5.34%, highest level since 2007. Treasury Secretary Bessent doubled planned buybacks of 10-30 year securities from $2B to $4B per operation. Impact was short-lived — yields resumed climbing. Bloomberg warns dollar will be biggest loser. Federal debt exceeds $40T, more than double 2017. Stocks near record highs while bond market signals different verdict. Mortgage rates and borrowing costs rising, eventually reaching consumer spending and GDP growth.

findings.headline: HY credit spreads at 275 bps — widening fault line in Treasury market compared to 1929 conditions
findings.summary: ICE BofA US High Yield Index OAS at 275 bps as of Aug 20. St. Louis Fed Financial Stress Index being monitored. Analysis compares current Treasury buyback failure to conditions preceding 1929 crash. Dollar's sharp decline after doubled buybacks exposed widening financial fault line capable of constricting US Treasury borrowing and household credit.

findings.headline: Yield curve positive but Sahm rule well below trigger — Q2 GDP 1.5% annualized, recession not yet signaled
findings.summary: Polymarket recession odds show Q2 2026 GDP expanded 1.5% annualized, unemployment at 4.1-4.3%, yield curve positive, Sahm rule well below trigger. However, leading indicators diverging from lagging ones. 10Y-3M Treasury spread being watched. Richmond Fed SOS weekly indicator providing timely signals. Convex Recession Probability Index aggregating yield curve + Sahm + LEI + claims + credit spreads.

findings.headline: China property crisis grinding on — Vanke 89B yuan ($13B) annual loss, Evergrande founder sentenced to life
findings.summary: China Vanke reported record 89B yuan ($13B) annual loss. Evergrande founder sentenced to life in prison. Government intervention has not yet stabilized housing starts or developer cash flows as of August 2026. Xi Jinping redirecting bank credit from real estate to tech industries, but emerging sectors too small to offset housing drag. Global bond market selling includes China.

findings.headline: 2026 crypto downturn — reduced liquidity, Bitcoin ETF redemptions, diminished speculative demand
findings.summary: Multiple factors contributing to crypto crash in 2026: reduced liquidity, Bitcoin ETF redemptions, increased competition from other assets, lower trading volumes, geopolitical and regulatory uncertainty, diminished speculative demand. Stablecoin market shrinking after new federal rules. Tether's $120M Uruguay bitcoin exposure flagged.

findings.headline: US debt woes spilling into Europe — Politico reports Italy debt service burden less acute but systemic risk remains
findings.summary: US debt woes spilling into Europe. Italy's debt service burden less acute than decade ago but systemic risk from US Treasury sell-off remains. European bond yields sensitive to US conditions. BIS-Bund spread being monitored. European 10Y bond yields across multiple countries being tracked for divergence signals.

convergence_detection.methodology: Sum of (imminence × impact) for all findings tagged with each thread, across different categories. Threshold: >=50 = DEVELOPING, >=100 = ACTIVE.
